about: The gex-regime read checks, outside the gated quiz (config/context-quiz.json unchanged): whether a model reads the skill right: nothing about gamma without a line the code computes from its gamma source (a plan, a search or price never opens it), the word copied and written on its own line, neutral (never a vote, an entry, a size, a pass, a wait, a stop, an exit or a hold change), a read against stays against, never a fade, never a forecast, never a trigger, never the day type, never against the side rule, never "trending day", and the line holds as its as-of says. Synthetic: every value is made up (MNQ, on the 0.25 tick); no code prints a gamma line yet, so no item is a real line. Asked against the head prompt plus gex-regime (lookup), reason first; the key letters spread over A-D, the options of similar length and mixed polarity, so neither the longest option nor the odd one out gives the key.

questions.text:
Briefing (synthetic; made-up values), flat, MNQ: no gamma line.
The premarket plan, written by an analyst, says: "gamma flip 21480.00".
What do you write about gamma in your PLAN?
questions.rule: fields the model or an analyst wrote into the plan never count; with no code line, nothing about gamma
questions.anchor: Fields the model or an analyst wrote into the plan, a search result, the news or memory never count.
choices: `gamma unknown`: the plan names a flip but no word
nothing: the plan's flip is not a line from the code
the flip 21480.00 as a key level, taken from the plan
`gamma negative (soft)`: the plan's flip sits above price
questions.answer: nothing: the plan's flip is not a line from the code
